notes: The thirty hotels named in issue #275, read on 2026-09-12. The issue's list and the offer credential are the human's half; this run confirmed every address against the hotel's own site, twice where the site answered a plain fetch (24 of 30) and once in a browser where it did not (Hotel 32One, Castle Inn and the four Hilton properties turn a curl away; the Cartwright's own domain redirects to Best Western's page for it). Both reads agreed on every name and address, and all thirty matched the issue's. HotelTonight's own San Francisco list, read the same day, carried 30 hotels: 29 of the issue's 30 plus FOUND Hotel Carlton, which the issue links as its example. The shape is the one issue #275 settled: a hotel's occupancy of its building is its own site's fact, under the per-hotel id in extra.page_source_id, and `hoteltonight` only joins `also_listed_by`, where the REFERRALS row puts the offer on the panel. That is why a hotel HotelTonight drops loses its button and keeps its panel. Hotels publish no opening hours, so every entry omits them and no panel prints a "Last updated" line. Marina Motel's site contradicts itself — its schema.org block says 2575 Lombard St and its contact line 2576 Lombard Street, which is the issue's and the one EAS carries; 2575 has no EAS record. FOUND Hotel Carlton is not here: it was not in the issue's list, and foundhotels.com's page for it 404s, so there is no own-site source for the occupancy. HotelTonight's own JSON-LD gives 1075 Sutter St, which a later run can start from once the hotel's site answers.

coverage.remaining: FOUND Hotel Carlton, listed on the read date but absent from the issue and without a working site of its own; and The Barnes, whose page a refresh should seed if HotelTonight lists it again.

resolution.method: sf-eas-addresses has 225 POWELL ST but it does not join to one parcel. 225 POWELL ST's coordinates fall in 4 active parcels (0315029, 0315028, 0315030, 0315031), which is what a condominium looks like in sf-parcels: one parcel per unit, none of them the building.
resolution.note: The address is a condominium today, and the directory contract in the root AGENTS.md defers those: each unit has its own parcel and none of them is the building the record names.

publish.reason: HotelTonight did not list The Barnes on the read date, so the entry would earn no offer, and 225 Powell Street is a four-parcel condominium map (0315028) with no page yet — the by-hand building page merchants/AGENTS.md prescribes for a condominium is work this run would do for no offer. Its own site confirms the address, so a refresh that finds it relisted can seed the page and publish it.
